As one of the trusted West Portal restaurants, we focus on using high quality ingredients and delivering attentive, friendly service that keeps guests coming back. Try a range of Mozzarella Di Bufala pizzas, fresh pastas, and traditional Brazilian dishes like feijoada. There's always something for everyone’s taste. If you’re seeking a spot where caring service and comfort blend seamlessly, you’re in the right place. Every visit is a chance to enjoy good food, good company, and the feeling of coming home. The menu is inspired by Pedro's passion for the authentic tastes of New York and Brazil and is always prepared fresh to order with local and seasonal ingredients. Whether you dine in or out, the NYC-style pizza and traditional Brazilian dishes will have you coming back for more.
